description: End-to-end test suite for the Embed Code Generator feature using Playwright. Contains tests for different embed types and page contexts (non-organization, organization, event types page, event type edit page). Includes utility functions for interacting with the UI and validating generated embed code snippets.

methods.name: chooseEmbedType
methods.description: Clicks on the embed type button based on the provided embedType.

methods.name: goToReactCodeTab
methods.description: Switches the UI to the React code tab after a delay.

methods.name: clickEmbedButton
methods.description: Clicks the embed button and retrieves its embed URL attribute.

methods.name: clickFirstEventTypeEmbedButton
methods.description: Opens the options menu for the first event type and clicks the embed button.

methods.name: expectToBeNavigatingToEmbedTypesDialog
methods.description: Waits for URL to navigate to the embed types dialog with specified embed URL.

methods.name: expectToBeNavigatingToEmbedCodeAndPreviewDialog
methods.description: Waits for URL to navigate to the embed code and preview dialog with specified parameters.

methods.name: expectToContainValidCode
methods.description: Validates that the embed code snippet is correct for the specified language and embed type.

methods.name: expectValidHtmlEmbedSnippet
methods.description: Checks the HTML embed code snippet for correctness and validity.

methods.name: assertThatCodeIsValidVanillaJsCode
methods.description: Uses Biome to validate JavaScript syntax of the code.

methods.name: assertThatCodeIsValidReactCode
methods.description: Uses Biome to validate JSX syntax of the code.

methods.name: expectValidReactEmbedSnippet
methods.description: Validates React embed code snippet and its syntax.

methods.name: expectToContainValidPreviewIframe
methods.description: Checks that the preview iframe has the correct src URL with embed parameters.
